  "symptoms": [
    "Heater command-actual mismatch (sym_heater_command_actual_mismatch)",

    "R_T_H and R_T_HH alarms active",

  "objective": "Restore CSTR temperature control by removing the stuck high heater condition and re-establishing safe, normal heater operation to bring reactor temperature back within setpoint range.",
  "candidate_levers": [
    {
      "type": "START_SPARE",
      "target": "E-101",
      "why": "KG evidence shows CSTR Heating Jacket (E-101) is the actuator subject to fault; starting the spare heater path could bypass the stuck primary heater and allow continued temperature control."
    },
    {
      "type": "SET_SETPOINT",
      "target": "R_TIC",
      "why": "R_TIC (Reactor Temperature Controller) drives act_param_cstr_heater_factor; lowering the MV commanded heater factor could reduce the affected heating when primary heater is stuck high, mitigating temperature rise while the spare path engages."
    }
  ],
  "constraints": [
    "Do not bypass safety interlocks; SIF_R_T_HH may latch if temperature remains high; ensure reset only if within hysteresis after stabilization",
    "If sensor fault evidence appears (e.g., op.R_TIC or TT-101 readings inconsistent beyond tolerance), escalate to sensor-check path"
  ],
  "kg_nodes": [
    "fault_reactor_heater_stuck_high",
    "sym_heater_command_actual_mismatch",
    "sym_reactor_temperature_high",
    "E-101",
    "R_TIC",
    "obs_param_cstr_temperature_K"
  ]
}
